name: Interpolate floats the same on macOS (nyx #3)

comments.text: The last failure on Dean's Mac, a-character-controller-lands-on-the-course, came from Nyx interpolating floats with std::to_string (libc++ prints 0.350000). Fixed in nyx #3. Dean to confirm 189 of 189 on the Mac with a fresh build-native.sh.
